model_boundary: A women’s-only multi-season forecast is published from separately retained team-box history. Men’s coefficients, calibration, IDs and forecast rows are never substituted.

checks.label: Completed WBB schedules
checks.detail: 2023–26 schedules provide the game IDs and chronology needed to reconcile team boxes.
checks.required: season, teams, stable game IDs and final status for every retained historical edition

checks.label: Completed WBB team boxes
checks.detail: 2023–25 ratings and a chronological 2026 holdout are required to compute team strength and outcomes.
checks.required: two final team rows per game keyed by game ID and team ID, with scores and stable team IDs

checks.label: Paired completed games
checks.detail: The artifact reports 5,897 completed 2026 holdout games after the multi-season model join.
checks.required: at least 100 valid completed games after score and duplicate checks

checks.label: Women’s probability calibration
checks.detail: A women’s probability calibration and margin interval are attached to the multi-season artifact and can be audited against its holdout.
checks.required: women’s calibration coefficients, calibration-game count and held-out Brier/log-loss evidence

checks.label: 2027 WBB target schedule
checks.detail: Upcoming schedule rows are context only until a separate WBB model passes the historical gates.
checks.required: scheduled games with stable game and team IDs

checks.label: 2027 WBB forecast-to-schedule alignment
checks.detail: 2,283 pregame source rows reconcile to the published forecast IDs and participant IDs.
checks.required: one forecast row for every retained pregame source row with matching game and participant IDs

checks.label: Published WBB forecast contract
checks.detail: The forecast artifact carries the women’s scope, target season, published model identity, and unique game rows with team IDs, dates, and predictions.
checks.required: sport=basketball, gender=women, target season, published WBB model ID, unique games, team IDs, dates, and prediction objects

next_steps: Import and hash-verify the 2023–26 women’s schedule and team-box releases under their exact release tags.
Join only on stable game and team IDs; retain unmatched, duplicate and invalid rows in the audit output.
Run a women’s-only chronological fit, then calibrate on one completed season and evaluate on the following season.
Register a WBB model ID and expose game probabilities only after the held-out metrics and source clocks pass publication checks.
